buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The bidder shall possess valid MSME Registration. 2. Mention the Brand and Model clearly in the technical bid. 3. The bidder/manufacturer shall have a minimum of 5 years of experience in the supply and installation of similar products. Proof of at least two completed contracts, each valued at a minimum of 50% of the present tender value, executed in Central/State Government institutions during the last five financial years, shall be submitted. 4. The bidder/manufacturer shall have a full fledged functional sales and service office within Tamil Nadu, and shall provide service support for all ICT tools supplied. Documentary proof such as GST Registration Certificate and Electricity Bill shall be submitted. OEM channel partner agreements or service tie ups shall not be accepted as valid proof. 5. The bidder shall submit documents to prove the performance/successful installations of the previous

supply and installations in central/state government institutions. 6. Product warranty shall be activated at the buyer’s premises. Failure to activate the warranty at the locations will result in withholding of payment. 7. The bidder shall quote the individual price for each item, although the tender will be evaluated and finalized on whole lot basis, not item wise. 8. The cost of equipment shall be inclusive of the price of the main equipment, accessories, transport, installation, and warranty. No separate charges for transport or installation shall be entertained. 9. Delivery shall be completed within 2–3 weeks from the date of receipt of the supply order. 10. The vendor shall supply all components in a single lot. Part supply is strictly not permitted. 11. No part or full payment will be released prior to completion of the entire supply. 12. The manufacturer/bidder shall provide total onsite warranty 3 years for all the items including accessories and cables supplied. 13. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the Tamil Nadu Tender Transparency Act, including provisions related to performance security, payment procedures, and compliance requirements. .
